title: Kesavananda Bharati v State of Kerala (1973)
summary: Parliament can amend the Constitution but cannot destroy its 'basic structure'.
principle: Basic structure doctrine limiting amendment power.

title: Maneka Gandhi v Union of India (1978)
summary: Passport impoundment case expanding Article 21 due process and connecting fundamental rights.
principle: Personal liberty, fair procedure, and interlinked fundamental rights.

title: Vishaka v State of Rajasthan (1997)
summary: Supreme Court laid down workplace sexual harassment guidelines until legislation.
principle: Gender equality, dignity, and international instruments in domestic law.

title: Justice K.S. Puttaswamy v Union of India (2017)
summary: Recognised privacy as a fundamental right flowing from dignity and autonomy.

title: S.R. Bommai v Union of India (1994)
summary: Federal intervention under President's Rule must meet judicially reviewable standards.
principle: Federalism and judicial review of emergency-style central takeovers.

title: Minerva Mills v Union of India (1980)
summary: Reinforced basic structure limits and balance between Parts III and IV of the Constitution.
principle: Harmony of fundamental rights and directive principles within basic structure.
